sourceVisibility.reason: The trigger observes acquisition events whose source actor is the equipped actor; AllHero on triggerEffectList controls effect recipients separately.
The trigger observes damage events sourced by the equipped actor; triggerEffectList.targetType controls effect recipients independently.

switchEnter.reason: TriggerSwitchEnter dispatches event 34 with the successfully entered hero as source and self. TriggerElement.Parse converts triggerInv milliseconds to runtime seconds before CanTrigger applies the interval gate.

onGotShield.reason: ShieldElement.Execute dispatches event 40 only on its successful new-shield path before SetShield. The reviewed branch does not close replacement or combine semantics for an already active shield instance.

afterHeal.reason: OnExecuteDamageElement settles the heal before OnAfterHeal. OnAfterHeal forwards the executor as the event Target and contains no effective-delta gate, so an executed heal at full HP still dispatches while rejected descriptors do not.

sourceVisibility.reason: Self is evaluated against each native event subject: entered actor for SwitchEnter, shield recipient for OnGotShield, and heal source actor for AfterHeal.

effectTarget.reason: InvokeTriggerElement_DamageHandle receives the healed executor as Target for AfterHeal; triggerEffectList.targetType=Target therefore resolves to that healed actor.
